senses.gloss: Latch,Ⓒs.ⒹargalA-laM, vizkaMBaH, argalAbaMDaH, tAlakaM, dvArabaMDanI; ‘the postern door was on the l(atch)’ argalAnirudDaM pakzadvAraM.

Late,Ⓒa.ⒹvilaMbena Agata or prApta; kAlAtIta, velAtIta, samayAtIta, atikrAMtakAla, ati-kAla, atItakAla-samaya.
Ⓑ
 2 avasita, pariRata, avasanna.
Ⓑ
 3 nUtana, acira, pratyagra, aBinava, ADunika (kI f.), nAtipurARa, sadyaskA-lIna.
Ⓑ
 4 atIta, gaMta, vyatIta, BUta; prAktana-pUrvatana (nI f.), pOrvika (kI f.), ‘at a l(ate) hour of the day’ pariRate divase, avasannaprAye ahani; ‘at a l(ate) hour of the night’ kzIRaBUyizWAyAM kzapAyAM; ‘at a l(ate) period of life’ pariRate vayasi.
Ⓔadv.ⒹvilaMbena, vilaMbAt, velAtikrameRa, atikAlaM-samayaM, cireRa, cirAt, cirakAlena-lAt; ‘to be l(ate)’ velAtikramaM kf 8 U, cira(rA)yati (D.); ‘why are you l(ate)’ kimiti cirA-yita tvayA; ‘l(ate) in life’ pariRatavayasi; See above; ‘too l(ate) in the day’ atiparAhRe; ‘too l(ate) in the evening’ atisAye.
Ⓑ
 2 akAle, asamaye.
Ⓝ[Late]ly,Ⓒ‘of late’, adv.ⒹidAnIMtane kAle, nAticirAtprAk, ADunika-samaye; aciraM.
Ⓝ[Late]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹkAlAtItatA, kA-lAtikramaH; pariRAmaH, pariRati f.
ⓃLater,Ⓒa.Ⓓuttara, apara, para, uttarakAlIna, pAScAtya.
Ⓔadv.Ⓓ(on) uttaraM, uttarottaraM, paScAt, uttara-para-kAle.
Latent,Ⓒa.Ⓓni-, lIna, gUQa, Canna, gupta, adfzwa, apratyakza, aprakASa, aprakawa, adfSya, aMtarhita, niBfta; ‘a l(atent) disease’ DAtusTaH-SarIrAMtargataH-rogaH.

Lateral,Ⓒa.ⒹpArSvIya, pArSvasTa, pArSvika (kI f.).
Ⓝ[Lateral]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹpArSvaBAge, pArSvataH, pArSve.

Latitude,Ⓒs.ⒹakzaH.
Ⓑ
 2 (Celestial) nikzepaH.
Ⓑ
 3 vistAraH, vistfti f., praTiman m., Ayati f.
Ⓑ
 4 aniyaMtraRaM, svAtaMtryaM, niyamopekzA, niya-mAtikramaH, SETilyaM; ‘degree of l(atitude)’ akzAMSaH; ‘l(atitude) of a planet’ patanaM; ‘parallel of l(atitude)’ akzAMSavfttaM.
ⓃLatitudinarian,Ⓒa.ⒹSiTila, aniyaMtraRa, niryaMtraRa.
Ⓔs.ⒹmatasvAtaMtryAvalaM-bin m., nirbaMDahInaH.
Ⓝ[Latitudinarian]ism,Ⓒs.ⒹmataSETilyaM, vicArasvAtaMtryaM, aniyaMtraRaM.

Latter,Ⓒa.Ⓓuttara, apara, para, avara, anya, (pron. a.); paScima, carama, aMtima; utta-rokta, aparokta; ‘former and l(atter)’ pUrvAparaM; ‘in the l(atter) part of the day’ parAhRe.
Ⓝ[Latter]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹarvAkkAle, aDunAtanakAle; See Lately.
Lattice,Ⓒs.ⒹjAlamArgaH, gavAkzaH, jAlaM, gavAkza-jAlaM, vAtAyanaM; ‘l(attice)-work’ jAlakarman n.
